title: Practice forgiveness until fear loosens
summary: Forgiveness, conduct, and contentment form the fast that frees the heart. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the wound starts speaking again, notice the jaw and stomach before the story hardens. Release one rehearsed sentence and let the body stop preparing for battle.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness, conduct, and contentment form the fast that frees the heart.
source.lifeApplication: When resentment rises, drop one sentence you keep feeding and stay with the breath.
